data.define: An idiom for very heavy rain.

misuse.text: Don't look for real animals when it's 'raining cats and dogs'.
misuse.why: It's an idiom for heavy rain.

data.l1_hook: Nhìn ra ngoài đi! Lấy dù nhanh!
data.l1_ex: Trời đang raining cats and dogs luôn!

native.tip: “raining cats and dogs” = Mưa như trút. Ví dụ: “It's raining cats and dogs!”
native.caption:
“raining…” nghĩa là gì?
“raining cats and dogs” = Mưa như trút.
Ví dụ: “It's raining cats and dogs!” (Trời đang raining cats and dogs luôn!)
